title: Diagnosing Blocked Plumbing Vents
description: A gurgling sink or slow-draining tub often points to a drainage ventilation problem rather than a clogged trap. When water flows through a drain pipe, it creates a negative pressure zone behind it. Without proper venting through the roof or an air admittance valve, air gets pulled through fixture P-traps, causing distinct gurgling sounds and siphoning water seals. Inspecting roof vents for bird nests, leaves, or frost closure is a critical troubleshooting step. Restoring proper airflow balances system pressure, allowing water to drain smoothly while preserving the protective trap seal that keeps sewer gases out of the building.
